description: North Carolina Department of Transportation (NCDOT) Work Zone Data Exchange (WZDx) is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Roadways and Bridges", published or maintained by U.S. Department of Transportation Intelligent Transportation Systems Joint Program Office (JPO) -- Recommended citation: "U.S. Department of Transportation Federal Highway Administration. (2022). North Carolina Department of Transportation (NCDOT) Work Zone Data Exchange (WZDx). [Dataset]. Provided by ITS DataHub through Data.transportation.gov. Accessed YYYY-MM-DD from https://doi.org/10.21949/1404211". This dataset provides archived information on work zones in the state of North Carolina in a tabular format. The ITS JPO has collections from 23 states including North Carolina covering various parts of the time period from 10/2019 to 08/2024 depending on when the feed was active. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Roadways and Bridges". It has 49 columns, among them data_source_update_frequency, update_date, vehicle_impact, event_status, end_date, ending_accuracy. The portal shows 2024-08-03 as the last data update. Attribution given: U.S. Department of Transportation Intelligent Transportation Systems Joint Program Office (JPO) -- Recommended citation:. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
